These red leather boots greedily absorb any blood they touch.

The boots produce a small pool of blood beneath your feet and in a free space you can see within 120 feet. You melt into the pool beneath you and reconstitute at the other pool, with the effects of translocate. Activate—Blood Walk 1 minute (concentrate, manipulate)

You melt into the ground and reconstitute at a location you have previously seen that's within 100 miles, with the effects of translocate. This effect fails if no sentient creature has died at that location in the past 24 hours.

Made of petrified wood, this mask evokes the form of a coral reef. When you wear it, you gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Swim, and any armor you're wearing gains the aquadynamic trait.

For 1 minute, your body becomes a mobile coral reef, letting much smaller creatures pass through or shelter in it. Creatures at least one size category smaller than you can share your space. Allies that share your space gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC, and you gain resistance 5 to any damage caused by a creature sharing the same space as you.

as an occult innate spell.The crown gains the following activation.
You cast a 6th-rank dominate with a DC of 30. When you cast dominate this way, its duration is reduced to 8 hours.

These glasses have faceted red lenses like those of a mantis and are popular as a less ostentatious alternative to a full mask. While wearing the gaze of the mantis, your field of view increases to give you better awareness of your surroundings. You gain a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks and cannot be flanked.

You learn the distance to and direction of all creatures that have a Red Mantis contract on them within 10 miles. If one of these creatures is within 100 feet, you also know any afflictions, conditions, and spells affecting them. This awareness lasts for 1 hour.

These fingerless gloves increase the agility and sensitivity of the hands, enabling the wearer to perform more delicate, precise work. While wearing the gloves of precision, you gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb, and to Thievery checks to disable-device and Pick a Lock.
You attempt a skill check to Climb, Disable a Device, or Pick a Lock
You roll the skill check twice and take the better result.

This pair of huge wings is crafted from numerous feathers made of a lightweight, golden magical alloy. When activated, the wings emit a melodic sound and a shimmering glow.

For the next 10 minutes, you can Leap 20 feet, using the wings to propel yourself. You must land on a space with solid ground. For the duration, you also emit a bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet. You take a –2 item penalty to Stealth checks to Hide and Sneak.

This cloak is made of turquoise scales that absorb moisture, hydrating the wearer. After being fully submerged in water for 1 hour, the cloak allows aquatic creatures, such as azarketis, to stay out of water for up to 1 week without penalties, after which it must be submerged again.

These tightly woven strips strengthen the hands and arms, allowing for the wearer to increase their application of force while lifting heavy loads, and shoving past blockades. Promise sculptors primarily use them to handle large blocks of stone, moving them around as they prepare to carve them. You gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to Force Open, Reposition, and Shove.
You attempt an Athletics check to Force Open, Reposition, or Shove
You roll the skill check twice and take the better result.

The swirls on this wooden mask—often worn by Mordant Censors—move and shift, reflecting the shape of the nearest currents. Wearing the mask grants you a +2 item bonus to Sailing Lore and Survival checks. In addition, it allows you to pilot a boat with simply a thought. When you pilot a vehicle, you can keep both hands free and Drive from any location on the vehicle.
for 1 minute or until you leave the vehicle, whichever comes first, and can use the extra action to Take Control of the vehicle or, if you're already piloting it, Drive or Stop the vehicle.

A constant murmuring, like waves washing up on the shore, fills your ears when you don this wooden mask. The soothing sounds grant you a +1 item bonus to your Will save and Will DC against emotion effects.
You would be affected by an auditory effect
The noise of the waves grow to an overwhelming, crashing booming, drowning out all other sounds. You become
to all other noise until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the activation up to 1 minute.

Carved concentric circles surround the eye and ear holes on this dark wooden mask, which lets you hear the whispers that fill the Mordant Spire. The barely audible susurrus that fills your ears advises you of peril, granting you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative and to Seek,
, or Sense Motive against things that intend harm to you, at the GM's discretion, such as hostile creatures and haunts. If you tie a foe's initiative roll, you go first.
You are about to attempt a check that your mythic calling would allow you to spend a Mythic Point on

You draw on the power of the Mordant Spire. You gain 1 Mythic Point, which you can spend to attempt the check. If you don't spend this point by the end of this turn, it is lost. You do not regain a Mythic Point if you critically succeed on the check, even if it's the first time you did so that day, but still do so on the subsequent critical success, as usual.
